paper.title_en: Spin precession in the strong deflection limit
paper.abstract_en: The strong deflection limit (SDL) of the deflection angle is well established for general spherically symmetric spacetimes, but a systematic SDL treatment of spin precession has been lacking. We derive the SDL expansion for the spin precession angle of particles propagating along geodesics in static, spherically symmetric, and asymptotically flat spacetimes. The SDL coefficients are obtained, and a simple relation linking the precession angle to the deflection one is established. Applying the formalism to Schwarzschild and Reissner-Nordström (RN) spacetimes, we obtain fully analytic SDL coefficients for the former and perturbative charge corrections to $\mathcal{O}(Q^2)$ for the latter. These results explicitly verify the universal spin-flip of massless particles in backward scattering, which is the underlying mechanism governing the absence of the glory spot. While the spin precession of massless particles is charge-independent, massive particles acquire a non-trivial charge dependence that distinguishes the RN case from Schwarzschild.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出了强偏转极限下自旋进动的系统处理方法，填补了这一空白。对史瓦西和赖斯纳-诺德斯特伦时空给出了解析结果，并验证了质量粒子后向散射中的自旋翻转。主题与强引力场中的粒子动力学相关，属于广义相对论基础领域。
decision.title_zh: 强偏转极限下的自旋进动
decision.abstract_zh: 对于一般球对称时空，偏转角的强偏转极限（SDL）已经得到充分确立，但自旋进动的系统SDL处理一直缺乏。我们推导了静态、球对称且渐近平坦时空中沿测地线传播的粒子自旋进动角的SDL展开。获得了SDL系数，并建立了自旋进动角与偏转角之间的简单关系。将该形式应用于史瓦西和赖斯纳-诺德斯特伦（RN）时空，我们获得了前者的完全解析SDL系数以及后者的$\mathcal{O}(Q^2)$阶微扰电荷修正。这些结果明确验证了无质量粒子在后向散射中的自旋翻转普遍性，这是控制光斑缺失的潜在机制。虽然无质量粒子的自旋进动与电荷无关，但有质量粒子获得了非平凡的电荷依赖性，这区分了RN情形与史瓦西情形。
